classification.difficultyReason: Angles on a straight line with three givens, as in p38-q4. The unlabelled right-angle square must be read as 90° and included, so there is one extra interpretation step before a one-step linear solve.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x&=180^\circ-30^\circ-90^\circ-24^\circ\\x&=36^\circ\end{align*}$$
